summary: All 30 source hashes and sizes matched, and all nine numerical claims reproduced. Of 231 author-selected genes, 157 have published local effects and 149 agree in direction. Coverage is 67.97%, below the 90% requirement. The corrected proposal distinguishes the workbook’s group values from fitted limma coefficients, explains the change from 179 historical pairs to 157 published pairs, and clarifies that three local discoveries have a dash in Table S4 while 40 are absent. The corrected proposal passed validation.
openIssues: The needs_author_contact closure remains justified. Tracing the eight opposite signs requires the authors’ sample-level rlog values, group-summary calculation, filtering code and gene-wise limma results.
